title: Electrocatalytic valorization of lignin
content:

Muhammad Bilal, Prashanth W. Menezes, Arne Thomas, Reinhard Schomäcker, Matthias Drieß, Frank Rosowski, Majd Al-Naji
This review discusses the electrochemical lignin valorization, including depolymerization to vanillin, benzoic acid, and quinones through oxidation and upgrading via hydrogenation/hydrogenolysis to produce value-added chemicals.
